fiction_notice: SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL. Every service, backup job, exercise, date and measurement in this file was invented for artifact review. Nothing here describes the University of Iowa, any real estate, or any real incident. Do not cite any figure in this file as a finding.
as_of_note: All staleness and age arithmetic is computed against this declared date, never against the wall clock, so two operators running this on different days get byte-identical output.

services.name: Course Registration Portal
services.business_function: A student can complete a course add/drop and receive a written confirmation.

services.name: Student Records Database
services.business_function: Authoritative student records can be read and written, and reads return current committed data.

services.name: Identity Provider (SSO)
services.business_function: A staff or student account can authenticate and receive a valid application session.

services.name: Directory Synchronization Service
services.business_function: Account attribute and group-membership changes propagate to downstream consumers.

services.name: Shared Object Store
services.business_function: Stored objects are retrievable and byte-identical to what was written.

services.name: Grade Submission Service
services.business_function: An instructor can submit final grades for a section and the submission is durably recorded.

services.name: LMS Integration Bridge
services.business_function: Roster and gradebook updates are exchanged with the learning management system.

services.name: Backup Control Plane
services.business_function: Backup and restore jobs can be scheduled, launched and monitored.

services.name: Backup Vault and Catalog
services.business_function: A named backup set can be located in the catalog and its contents streamed back.
